title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Clause on Open Cases per Loan
content:
**Clause 1 — one open payoff case per loan (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction).**

1.1 A requester may hold payoff cases on more than one loan, such as a successor settling two estates; there is no limit on the number of loans on which one requester holds payoff cases. A loan, however, has at most the plan's largest number of open payoff cases at a time.

1.2 A payoff case is opened only when the loan has no other payoff case whose status is opened, terms issued or accepted. The test is made against the system's payoff case records for that loan (the HECM or the Summit loan the case is opened on) before the case is opened; what a requester says about other cases does not replace those records.

1.3 A request on a loan that already has an open case is handled on that case: new figures are reissued on it rather than opening a second case, and a request under a different plan withdraws nothing until the requester withdraws the open case.

1.4 A plan applies only to a loan program listed among the plan's covered loan programs, and the plans other than the Borrower Voluntary Payoff and the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff apply only while the loan has a maturity case that is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, as the plan's maturity-case requirement provides; otherwise the request is declined for the reason that the plan is not available.

### Condition and result

| Records of the loan at the time of the request | Result |
|---|---|
| No payoff case on the loan with status opened, terms issued or accepted | a new payoff case may be opened |
| A payoff case on the loan with status opened, terms issued or accepted | no second case is opened; the request is handled on the open case |
| Earlier payoff cases on the loan, all satisfied, lapsed or withdrawn | a new payoff case may be opened |
| Plan does not cover the loan's program, or needs a maturity case in one of the three statuses and the loan has none | declined: plan not available |

A successor who holds an open payoff case on a parent's loan and another on a second estate's loan holds two cases on two loans, which clause 1.1 permits.
